verdict.rationale: Pulley explicitly offers in-platform 409A valuations with a fast 3-day turnaround and describes them as 'audit-defensible,' produced by their expert team, implying integration with the company's live cap table data. However, there is no explicit evidence of automatic 'on schedule' refresh/renewal scheduling or direct confirmation that valuations are generated programmatically from live cap table data versus a service workflow layered on top. Missing for 10: documented automatic refresh/renewal scheduling cadence, explicit description of live cap-table-driven generation (vs. analyst-assisted service), and independent/third-party corroboration of audit-readiness.
